# vengtoo_group_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a role to a group, granting it to every member of the group. Deleting this resource unassigns the role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group to assign the role to.
- `role_id` (String) Role to assign.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: group_id:role_id
